description.value: Decathlon is a large international sporting goods chain located inside the Metropolis at Metrotown shopping mall in Burnaby. The store carries gear for a broad range of sports including cycling, and appears to offer maintenance and repair services that can be booked in-store. A touring cyclist could find replacement accessories or basic cycling components here, though the cycling department is one section within a big-box retail environment.
